method: Merge of PR #4135 (HEAD 1853bde32, wire.settings e5e0350167c0, last receipt passed vs en d1f1d715f520) with main (MERGE_HEAD eb872993c, wire.settings a651420d8ab1, last receipt passed vs en beb522ed3593); merge-base 23398503e. Mechanical, whole namespace (883 keys): key set equals en and the union of both parents minus deletions; every non-patched value is byte-identical to the side that changed it (no both-sides conflicts, no reverts); placeholder parity, backtick code-span parity, NFC and no bidi/control chars all pass; the source has no ICU plural/select, so there are no plural categories to check. Key order differs from en only in the session_cleanup_temporary_idle_minutes choices, which is pre-existing at the merge base and not a translation issue. Semantic: all 14 merge keys (update_auto_prune.*, update_keep_generations.{label,help}, updates.{title,description}, bash_heavy_jobs_enabled.*, heavy_jobs.{title,description}) checked against en and the en context sidecar for meaning, prune/keep safety, glossary and fit. Safety holds: every rendering deletes only unused/old installs, and keep_generations.help leads with the complete always-kept clause (current, previous, running, registered) within the 146-cell budget. The other 869 keys were not re-scored: they are value-identical to bytes that already carry passed receipts on a parent.
